Title: Lyra: a place to begin
Description: Bring 8 Wood for the atelier. Gather quests consume|their materials when you claim the reward.

Title: Lyra: silk and self-expression
Description: Bring 3 Silk. At a Loom, turn Cobwebs into Silk.|Lyra is a trans woman rebuilding her own atelier.

Title: A room of your own
Description: Bring 2 Moonprism Bars from the Reverie.|A Prism Wardrobe saves and restores appearance presets.

Title: Through the garden mirror
Description: Craft a Garden Mirror and use it to enter the Reverie.|Use either portal key again to return home.

Title: Crystal orchard survey
Description: Bring 9 Moonprism Ore from beneath the orchard floor.|Smelt 3 ore into 1 bar at a Furnace.

Title: A guardian in the roots
Description: Use a Rootbound Seal in the Reverie and defeat|the Rootbound Knight. Strike after its charge.

Title: The cracked bell
Description: Craft a Cracked Bell Portal and enter the Hush.|The archive contains a lantern and an encounter sigil.

Title: Follow the false light
Description: Defeat a Lantern Stalker in the Hush.|It becomes visible and faster before a charge.

Title: Break the silence
Description: Use a Cracked Bell Sigil in the Hush and defeat|the Bellkeeper. Move through gaps in its echo rings.

Title: Wings across the moon
Description: In Hardmode, use a Prism Cocoon in the Reverie.|Defeat the Prism Matriarch for scales and a moth pet.

Title: Noticeboard: safer paths
Description: Help defeat 20 hostile creatures anywhere.|Statue creatures and peaceful wildlife do not count.

Title: A shell out of water
Description: Use a Reef Shell in the Reverie to challenge|the Reefback Guardian, an optional early miniboss.
